summary: Create one Xchange Telecom LLC company and treat Skywire Networks as its division and commercial alias, not a separate investment. NOVA acquired 100% of founder equity through NOVA-Xchange Investco, L.P. on November 28, 2022; current NOVA and 2026 New York regulatory evidence continue to support NOVA control, and no later ownership transfer was found.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The founders' internal ownership split and transaction price are not publicly disclosed.
The website footer reverses the d/b/a wording, but current regulator, contract and privacy evidence support Xchange Telecom LLC as the legal carrier and Skywire as its division.
New York PSC post-order acceptance filings and fiber route miles were not located.
recommendedActions: Create one canonical Xchange Telecom LLC company with Skywire Networks, Skywire, Skywire Powered by Xchange and Xchange Telecom Corp. as aliases.
Add NOVA Infrastructure as the active 100% owner through NOVA-Xchange Investco, L.P. from November 28, 2022 with Fund I attribution.
Preserve Alan Levy and Alfred West as former founders/owners who exited at the 2022 close without inventing their undisclosed split.
Exclude Utah Skywire Fiber LLC, lender vehicle NOVA-Skywire HoldCo, passive fund investors and individual network assets from direct PortCo ownership.
